dex.text: Trots out of the furnace in a row with its brothers and sisters, all glowing like coals and squealing for their mum. Do not pat it. Seriously, do not pat it.
dex.fact: Pig iron is named after its sand moulds: a long channel with little moulds branching off it, which looked like a litter of piglets feeding from a sow.

dex.text: A great iron sow that lies in the casting house sighing out sparks. Its piglings follow it everywhere, and so does the smell of hot metal and Sunday dinner.
dex.fact: In 1709 Abraham Darby I smelted iron with coke instead of charcoal at Coalbrookdale, making cheap iron possible and helping to start the Industrial Revolution.
